newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA WHEAT HARVEST SEEN ABOUT 7.8 MLN TONNES.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA WHEAT HARVEST SEEN ABOUT 7.8 MLN TONNES.

text.p: Romania is expected to bring in a wheat harvest of about 7.8 million tonnes this year, up from last year's figure of 3.1 million tonnes, Agriculture Minister Dinu Gavrilescu said on Friday.
"We expect to get at least the level in 1995," Gavrilescu told Reuters, referring to that year's bumper crop of 7.8 million tonnes. Romanian exports in 1995 amounted to 1.3 million tonnes.
On Wednesday, a ministry official said vegetation on 2.3 million hectares of the 2.39 million put under wheat was "absolutely remarkable, the best we have had over the past six years".
Data showed density on the 2.3 million hectares exceeded 400 plants per square metre, the official said.
Heavy rains have hit Romania in recent weeks and floods submerged large areas of cropland, but the adverse weather has subsided.
Analysts said the rains had helped the crops get the necessary water supplies after a relatively dry winter. Last
year, Romania planted 2.11 million hectares to wheat, but an early winter and late snow damaged the crop on almost half that area. The harvest fell to 3.1 million tonnes, a record low.
